ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio is heavily weighted toward low-intensity pixels; visible surface is approximately 97% dark pigmentation with localized high-intensity (white) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Visible surface is a contiguous black geometric mass. Distinct high-contrast white focal spots are mapped to the lower-medial region of the right lobe and scattered at a lower frequency across the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch calculated at an approximate 55-degree pixel angle with a depth ratio of roughly 1:4 relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration map along the trailing boundary; features a sequence of jagged peaks with 5-12 pixel amplitudes and narrow valleys, with highest frequency observed on the medial segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory fitting the outer margins of both lobes, sweeping from the central axis upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast (beige) pixel groups concentrated specifically on the distal tips and the anterior-distal edges of both lobes, representing barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) detected on the medial-lower quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of barnacle-induced calcification localized at the outer tips of both lobes; no major tissue amputations or macroscopic trauma lesions visible in current resolution.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the fluke exhibit a unique thickened topography due to extreme localized barnacle encrustation, altering the expected smooth sweep of the lobe.
